questions.text: In the current season of your life, do you feel like you're the younger or the older brother from the Prodigal Son parable?
Looking at the Parable of the Sower, which type of soil best represents your heart right now — and why?
Do you agree with "once saved, always saved"?
Is there a verse that used to confuse or bother you that now means something different?
Which book of the Bible do you keep coming back to, and why?
Is there a Biblical character whose struggle you deeply relate to right now?
God is described in many ways throughout Scripture — Father, Shepherd, Refuge, Healer. Which name of God feels most personal to you right now?
Jesus asked His disciples, "Who do you say I am?" — how would you answer that question in your own words, right now?
Where have you seen God's love in your life recently?
In which season of your life do you feel the most loved by God?
Why do you love Jesus?
Moving forward, what's one thing you would want to do to build a relationship with God?
Have you ever felt far away from God?
In what ways has your walk with Christ changed you?
Has your image of God changed over the years — who did you think He was, and who do you know Him to be now?
Is there something God has been trying to teach you that you keep resisting?
What's a moment where you felt God showed up in a way you couldn't explain?
If you had encountered Christianity as an adult with no prior exposure, do you think you would still choose to follow Jesus? Why or why not?
What are you most grateful for about the person beside you?
What fruits of the Spirit have you received from other people?
Who is walking ahead of you in faith, alongside you, and who are you helping walk with Christ?
Who in your life shows you what unconditional love looks like, and how have they shaped your faith?
Is there someone you've been called to forgive but haven't yet — what's holding you back?
How do you carry your faith into spaces where it might not be welcomed?
Is there a person in your life who you think God placed there intentionally — and have you ever told them?
How do you respond when someone you love holds beliefs or makes choices that conflict with your faith?
Is there a way your community has failed you — and have you been able to find healing from that?
What's one way you've seen God work through another person to reach you?
Do you find it easier to receive love or to give it — and why do you think that is?
Ask the person beside you: how do you see my faith in the way I treat others?
What are the 3 things you are most grateful for this week?
If Jesus were in your contact list, what would you name Him?
If you could send one text to Jesus, what would it be?
Who's your favorite character in the Bible other than Jesus?
What's your #1 go-to worship song?
Share your favorite verse — why is it meaningful to you?
Rate your prayer life this week: text message, voice note, or full phone call — and why?
If you could have dinner with any figure from the Bible (besides Jesus), who would it be and why?
If your faith were a weather report right now, what would it be?
